snippet.title: Super Smash Bros. 3D Release Trailer, Play Online!
snippet.description:
The very first total-conversion SM64 hack! By the next version, there will be no more distinguishable features leftover from SM64. Most of the controls, physics and other elements of the game are completely re-written.

Download: http://skelux.root.sx/showthread.php?tid=855

----Big thanks to these people for helping make this possible----
Hailbot: Model rips for SSBB stages, title screen logo
PablosCorner: All music imports
Quasmok: Hud graphics
Subdrag: N64 Sound Tool usage

Funding/Demos: https://www.patreon.com/skelux
Discord: https://skelux.root.sx/forumdisplay.php?fid=18
Twitter: https://twitter.com/BonerLich
Forum: http://skelux.root.sx
Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/bonerlich
